brief:
Autostart currently starts a PR as soon as its dependencies reach in_review. Add an option so that, for a chosen target, autostart waits until every dependency of a PR has merged before starting it.

Requirements:
1. The wait is set per autostart target and is off by default.
2. Holds must follow the live dependency graph: editing depends_on while a PR is held takes effect without restarting the TUI.
3. A dependency closed without merging must not hold its dependents forever.
4. The TUI log shows why a PR is held.
Do not change how merges themselves are detected.
strong:
# Wait-for-merge autostart

Autostart can now hold a PR until all of its dependencies have merged, configured per target and off by default.

## Behaviour

A held PR is re-evaluated on every autostart poll against the current dependency graph, so edits to depends_on apply on the next poll. A dependency closed without merging counts as released and is logged. Each hold writes one log line naming the dependencies still open. Merge detection is unchanged.

## PRs

### PR: Merge wait for autostart targets
- **description**: Add a per-target wait flag; derive holds at poll time from dependency status; release on merge or closed-unmerged; log hold reasons.
- **tests**: held while a dependency is open; starts within one poll after merge; depends_on edit releases or adds a hold without restart; closed-unmerged releases with a log line; flag off keeps current behaviour.
- **files**: pm_core/tui/auto_start.py, tests

# Wait-for-merge autostart

## Introduction

Software projects often have many pull requests, and these pull requests frequently depend on each other. Managing dependencies is an important part of any software project, and it is important to note that good dependency management can help teams work more effectively. In this plan, we will describe an improvement to autostart.

## Overview

As mentioned in the introduction, autostart can now hold a PR until all of its dependencies have merged. In other words, a PR will wait for its dependencies to merge. This is configured per target and is off by default, which means that it will not be enabled unless a user chooses to enable it.

## Behaviour

A held PR is re-evaluated on every autostart poll against the current dependency graph, so edits to depends_on apply on the next poll. A dependency closed without merging counts as released and is logged. Each hold writes one log line naming the dependencies still open. Merge detection is unchanged.

## Summary

To summarise, this plan adds a merge wait to autostart. As described above, holds are derived from the dependency graph and released when dependencies merge. This will help users manage their PRs more effectively.

- **tests**: held while a dependency is open; starts within one poll after merge; depends_on edit releases or adds a hold without restart; closed-unmerged releases with a log line; flag off keeps current behaviour.
